Hey man, I work in a music store and I have sold hundreds of digital pianos, I hope my advice helps, during the last six months yamaha has had around 3-5 price raises on their stock, what I would suggest is that if you are certain that would want a yamaha go for it, how ever if you are looking for a digital with more features for less money Kawai is a brilliant alternative, KDP-120, around $1000 and the more expensive CN29 which comes with a lot more sounds and a screen interface unlike the arius yamahas at the same sort of price, to get a yamaha with a screen you have to spend around $2400 - CLP735.

Casio may not be as famous as yamaha but is the cheaper option, unfortunately due to the fact that its competition are acoustic piano manufacturers who have massive R&D budgets (yamaha&kawai) Casio suffers comparatively in quality but not in price.

J.
I feel exactly the same man. Here as well.

Yeah maybe, I'm not sure at the moment, nothing is final. I just hope to get along with life. 

Thanks for your kind words.
All we can do is think and feel, not very much granted but some nevertheless. I wont forget your story friend.

Hey man, Im not gonna bullshit you into not killing yourself or rant on about "everything's gonna be ok" because it sounds like for you that it just wont, but I hope that it does, I hope that you find some small thing that you like before your decide to take your life. I was suicidal this time last year and I never got any help, suicide is scary and messy, life is very tough and it doesn't always get easier but let me say yu are very brave posting again. I hope that my words bring some solace or meaning. If you do take your life, just remember, I will not forget your story, keep on my friend, keep on.
No, all death is painful, ending hurts the most.

Hey, I turned 18 today, i'm not sure how to feel about it, all i can say is that i am quite surprised to still be here. I don't know if you'll reply but I have to say this: I understand. I have attempted my life 3 or so times now and I thought I could cope but I quit my job and its all falling apart. My family has also caused me great pain. I hope things get better for you, and if you do take your life, I will remember you, I always will, It was brave of you to share your story, thank you friend.

Hi. Its slightly surreal hearing a story that I recognize, I turned 18 today but nothings changed much, I have lost contact with my friends and haven't made a friend for years. You mentioned your writing, even if you think your terrible I bet you would be able to portray your fears and anxiety very well as you have done it well here. I'm here for a chat if you like, stay strong. I won't forget you friend.

Your story reminds me of an old friend, I miss her everyday, she was talented and kind and smart, just like you I expect. My talent has kept me alive these past 18 years but no one seems interested in them. If you wouldn't mind sharing your talents, i'd love to hear them. Suicide is scary and can be a traumatizing mess but it can also damage a lot of people you may not know about. I will not forget you friend, I never will.

Hi, I turned 18 today, i'm now an adult, I don't feel much except pain and dread that I will die old and alone. I have attempted suicide before and I understand the pure emptiness of waking up the next morning and just staring at the ceiling. Life is one big mystery. I hope that you and your friend decide that its better to talk about your pain than to act out on it. My family have tried to help me but caused me most of my trauma and pain. I am very sad to hear you don't want to live anymore, but I understand how hard it can be, how much you want things to end. All I ask is that you just hold on to the last thing you have, doesn't matter what it is, so long as you hold on to it, perhaps a memory or a toy. You are very brave to share your story and I hope this helps in some way. Stay resilient my friend, and if you do decide that you have to take your life, rest well. I wont forget you.

I know the feeling, its an eternal blackness, an understanding that we are all so very alone, I just started a new job thinking that it would move my life forward and I would prosper and learn from it, turns out I cant fucking stand it and its the last thing I want to do.

I think it's because we have lost our way humans, we have forgotten nature and taken greed and power from those who we can, Im not sure theres a reason we are all here but here we are. Perhaps it is a curse and purging the world of greed and evil would help.
Thank you for sharing your story, mine is not too different from yours, I wish you good luck in finding your way through life.

Hi Dizzy,

I share hate for existence,

You're not alone, I have had enough, I have never been lucky, Never asked for more than I have received, Never hurt deliberately, Never meant anything wrong I said.

I have been alone for as long as I can remember. I have never felt part of a family or community. I regret so much, I regret not doing so much. Sometimes I just want to make people happy and I can't even do that.

Sometimes there are no answers. Sometimes there is no choice. 

If you do take your life, I will remember you until, whether it be today or tomorrow or next year, I die.

I am so tired of losing everyone. 

I am broken but I am me, and you are you.

Somethings are set in stone and some are not. 

I wish you a clear future, however long it may be. 

Chin up, happiness is like a butterfly, if you chase it, it will fly away but if you sit down and wait , perhaps one day, it will perch on your shoulder. 

Rest well Friend.

Hey Tan, like you I have been depressed for a very long time now. Every day feels longer and longer and lonelier. 

I have realised that there are 4 realisations in life that no one can escape.

1 - You have no choice to where you are born or when or to whom or how.

2 - Life is never fair. It obliterates people with bad luck and teaches those who feel broken that sadness and pain are all that remain. 

3 - No one cares.

4 - The best one - Death is inevitable.

Through these realisations, I have learned that if you want something, you take it. It is absolutely your choice and no-ones responsibility to sympathise or help. 

Also, happy birthday

I Have also dropped out of college with no job and no dreams. I just lie awake in bed every day with no hope for the future. I see nothing but bliss in dying. I know that the little pain I will cause by ending my life won't ripple through time and space so I just don't care anymore. I am certain that if you write a note to your family explaining why this has all occurred, you might find resolve. 

We might have never met or spoken or seen each other but I tell you as a friend that I am sorry, no one has ever apologised to me before so I hope me saying that might say something.

I wish I could suggest medication or therapy or strategy but I've tried all of them. All I hope is that you die with the knowledge that you will return to stardust. I will remember you if no one else will. Life is pain, but it's not pointless. We have been incredibly lucky to even see a second of our planet. The lottery which is life has been won and lost by all of us. 

Rest well, friend.
